title: Design System: Possistem QR Order Menu
scope: QR order menu only (/qr/<menu>/<table>/, src/components/qr). The possistem.az marketing site (src/styles/site.css, Montserrat / Space Grotesk) is a separate, undocumented system and out of scope.

muted.note: About 6:1 on linen for every accent

notice-amber.note: Used as color-mix(in oklab, #c27a10 12%, paper) ground; text color-mix(in oklab, #7a4300 80%, ink)

display.purpose: Category headings; 30px from 760px; over a 2px ink rule.

headline.purpose: Dish sheet title; receipt title at 22px.

brand.purpose: Restaurant name in the header; 24px from 760px; one line with ellipsis.

title.purpose: Dish names in rows; 18px from 760px; 16px for basket lines.

body.purpose: Base text and every input (16px prevents phone zoom).

label.purpose: Tabs, option legends, field labels, button text (600-700).

meta.purpose: Option summaries, counts, steps, unavailable pill, fees (12-13px).

price.purpose: Every price, total, count and quantity; tabular lining, nowrap, right-aligned.

shadows.name: plate-rim
shadows.value: 0 0 0 4px var(--qr-paper), 0 0 0 5px var(--qr-rule), 0 6px 14px -6px color-mix(in oklab, var(--qr-ink) 45%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Dish photos and empty plates in rows.

shadows.name: plate-small
shadows.purpose: Plates in basket lines and loading; on the spread bar the ring is 0 0 0 2px var(--qr-accent).

shadows.name: spread-glow
shadows.value: 0 14px 30px -12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--qr-accent) 70%, #000), 0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--qr-ink) 40%, transparent)

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focus-visible element; should follow the element's own radius.

shadows.name: sticky-veil
shadows.value: background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--qr-linen) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--qr-rule)
shadows.purpose: Sticky header and tabs; separates by blur, not shadow.

motion.name: plate-land
motion.value: qr-land .6s ease-settle: from translateY(-34px) scale(.5) opacity 0, overshoot to translateY(3px) scale(1.08)
motion.purpose: A newly chosen dish dropping onto the spread.

motion.name: sheet-rise
motion.value: qr-sheet .42s ease-settle: from translateY(40px) opacity .4; overlay qr-fade .25s ease-out

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: Current order step; loading plates staggered .15s.

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform .2s ease-settle; scale(.9) add button, scale(.98) primary

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Larger type and plates; centred dialogs; 3:1 cover; sticky offset 162px.

breakpoints.name: pointer
breakpoints.purpose: All hover styles live here only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves the order forward: add to the table, send to the till.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); color: #fff; font: 700 16px/1 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #c9cacc; color: #fffdf9; cursor: default; }

components.name: Add Button
components.description: Round 44px add on every dish row; fills with the accent and shows the count once chosen.
components.css: .ds-add { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--qr-paper, #fffdf9); color: var(--qr-ink, #1e232c); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #bdbdbf; font: 750 16px/1 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-add:hover:not(.is-chosen) { background: var(--qr-soft, #e8ecf4); } .ds-add:active { transform: scale(.9); } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-add.is-chosen { background: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); color: #fff; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Category Tabs
components.description: Sticky horizontal pills; the current category carries the accent.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 0; background: var(--qr-linen, #efefee); } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: var(--qr-muted, #555960); font: 600 14px/1 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .25s; } .ds-tabs button:hover:not([aria-current=true]) { color: var(--qr-ink, #1e232c); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tabs button[aria-current=true] { background: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); color: #fff; }

components.name: Table Band
components.description: The cloth's band under the header naming the guest's table.
components.html: Sifariş masayaTerras · Masa 7
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); color: #e2e9f4; font: 400 14px/1.3 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band strong { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Dish Row
components.description: Plate, name, description, tabular price and add button between hairlines; unavailable dishes restyle in place.
components.html:
• PepperoniAcılı kolbasa, mosarella, oreqano.15.00 ₼
  • Tiramisu7.00 ₼Hazırda yoxdur
components.css: .ds-dishes { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--qr-linen, #efefee); font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--qr-ink, #1e232c); } .ds-dish { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--qr-rule, #d5d6d6); } .ds-plate { width: 76px; height: 76px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #fbfcff 0 46%, #b9c6e0 48% 49.5%, #eaeef6 51% 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--qr-paper, #fffdf9), 0 0 0 5px var(--qr-rule, #d5d6d6), 0 6px 14px -8px rgba(30,35,44,.4); } .ds-dish-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-dish-name { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-dish-desc { font-size: 14px; color: var(--qr-muted, #555960); } .ds-dish-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; } .ds-price { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-add-mini { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--qr-paper, #fffdf9); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #bdbdbf; font-size: 22px; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add-mini:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dish.is-out .ds-dish-name, .ds-dish.is-out .ds-price { color: var(--qr-muted, #555960); } .ds-dish.is-out .ds-price { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-dish.is-out .ds-plate { filter: grayscale(1); opacity: .6; } .ds-out { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--qr-muted, #555960); padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qr-rule, #d5d6d6); }

components.name: Spread Bar
components.description: The table's spread fixed at the foot of the screen: overlapping plates of chosen dishes, count, table and total.
components.css: .ds-spread { width: 100%; min-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); color: #fff; text-align: left; font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -12px #0f2c60, 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(30,35,44,.4); } .ds-spread:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-spread-plates { display: flex; padding-left: 4px; } .ds-spread-plates span { width: 38px; height: 38px; margin-left: -12px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #fbfcff 0 44%, #b9c6e0 46% 48%, #eaeef6 50% 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); } .ds-spread-plates span:first-child { margin-left: 0; } .ds-spread-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-spread-text strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-spread-text small { font-size: 12px; color: #c9d6ee; } .ds-spread-total { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 750; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Option Choice
components.description: A 52px linen row per option in the dish sheet; selected rows take the soft tint and an inset accent ring.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: var(--qr-paper, #fffdf9); font-family: Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--qr-linen, #efefee); color: var(--qr-ink, #1e232c); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-choice:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice.is-on { background: var(--qr-soft, #e8ecf4); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); } .ds-choice input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); } .ds-choice span { flex: 1; font-size: 15px; } .ds-choice em { font-style: normal; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--qr-muted, #555960); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Note and name fields in sheets; hairline border that turns accent on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 650 14px/1.3 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--qr-ink, #1e232c); } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--qr-rule, #d5d6d6); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--qr-paper, #fffdf9); font: 400 16px/1.45 Onest, system-ui, sans-serif; color: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--qr-accent, #1f56b8); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--qr-muted, #555960); }

narrative.overview:
The guest's table is the page. A warm linen ground, deep ink type, and the restaurant's own colour running through it as the band of the tablecloth: the strip that names the table, the active category, the chosen dishes and the button that sends the order. Dishes sit on round plates, chosen dishes land as overlapping plates on the spread at the foot of the screen, and prices stand in one tabular column on the right. The menu begins in the first screen; there is no introduction to scroll past.

The page belongs to the restaurant, not to Possistem. The accent, logo and name are the restaurant's; the whole neutral palette is tinted from that accent, so a burgundy restaurant gets a rosy linen and a green one a sage linen without anyone choosing a second colour. Possistem appears only as a small signature link in the footer. Density is a printed menu's: flat rows divided by hairlines, one column, generous touch targets, nothing boxed.

Light only (`color-scheme: light`). The world is a laid table in restaurant light; there is no dark variant.
keyCharacteristics: One accent per restaurant (blue, green, burgundy, amber), set by `data-accent`, used only for what is active or chosen.
Neutrals derived from the accent by oklab mixing; never chosen per restaurant.
Bitter for names of things (restaurant, category, dish sheet, receipt), Onest for everything read or tapped.
Round plates for every dish image and every chosen dish; an empty plate when there is no photo.
Hairline-ruled rows, not cards; prices tabular and right-aligned.
Bottom sheets on phones, centred dialogs from 760px.

rules.name: The Cloth Band Rule
rules.body: The accent marks what is active or chosen and nothing else. If an element is neither the table, the current category, a chosen dish, a selected option, progress, or the action that sends the order, it is not accent-coloured.

rules.name: The Tinted Linen Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are never picked per restaurant. They are mixed from the accent so the whole page shifts with one setting; a new neutral is added as another `color-mix` of the existing tokens, not as a fixed hex.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bitter names places and things (restaurant, category, the dish in its sheet, the receipt). Onest does everything else. Bitter never appears on a button, price, tab or form.

rules.name: The Tabular Column Rule
rules.body: Every number the till will charge is set in tabular lining figures, never wraps, and sits right-aligned in its own column, so prices read down the page like a printed bill.

rules.name: The Things On The Table Rule
rules.body: Only objects that sit on the table (plates, the spread, the receipt, sheets) cast shadows. Rows, headings, tabs and the page ground stay flat.

rules.name: The Round Plate Rule
rules.body: Food is always on a round plate. A dish without a photo gets the empty plate in the same slot, never a letter, icon or stock picture.

dos: **Do** take every derived colour from the `--qr-*` mixes of the accent; adding a fifth accent means one new `data-accent` value and nothing else.
**Do** keep every touch target at 44px or more and inputs at 16px.
**Do** set every price, total and count in tabular lining figures, right-aligned, nowrap.
**Do** put food on round plates and keep the plate slot fixed across rows, using the empty plate when there is no photo.
**Do** restyle unavailable dishes in place (muted, struck price, greyscale plate, pill) rather than hiding or reordering them.
**Do** gate hover styles behind `@media (hover: hover)` and drop all animation under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
**Do** keep Possistem to the footer signature; the restaurant's name, mark and colour lead.
donts: **Don't** box dishes in cards or a photo grid; dishes are hairline-ruled rows.
**Don't** open with a hero banner or a slider; the cover is at most a short strip under the header.
**Don't** use the accent for decoration, headings or body text.
**Don't** fill a missing dish photo with a letter, icon or stock food picture (the restaurant mark's initial is the logo fallback, not a dish placeholder).
**Don't** set Bitter on controls, prices or tabs.
**Don't** use offset or hard-edged shadows; only objects on the table cast soft ones.
